title: Quadratic Metric Elicitation for Fairness and Beyond
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on eliciting mathematical performance metrics for machine learning classifiers, particularly in the context of fairness for generic protected groups.
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion, as it is not a subject of the research. The work focuses on a novel method for eliciting quadratic performance metrics for classification tasks, with applications to algorithmic fairness across unspecified or general protected groups.
